verifyBody:
Hello {{userName}},

Please verify your account by clicking the link below:
{{link}}

This link expires in 1 hour.

If you didn't create an account, please ignore this email.
resetPasswordBody:
Hello {{userName}},

You requested a password reset. Click the link below to reset your password:
{{link}}

This link expires in 15 minutes.

If you didn't request this, please ignore this email.
welcomeBody:
Hello {{userName}},

Welcome to Green Quick! Your account has been successfully created.

You can now start exploring our platform.
orderPlacedSubject: Your Green Quick Order #{{orderId}} is Placed!
orderPlacedBody:
Hello {{userName}},

Thank you for your order! Your order #{{orderId}} has been successfully placed and is awaiting confirmation from the shop. We'll send you another email once it's confirmed.

Order Summary:
{{orderSummaryHtml}}

Total: {{totalAmount}}
Payment Method: {{paymentMethod}}
Delivery Address: {{deliveryAddress}}

Thank you for shopping with Green Quick!
orderConfirmedSubject: Your Green Quick Order #{{orderId}} is Confirmed!
orderConfirmedBody:
Hello {{userName}},

Great news! Your order #{{orderId}} has been confirmed by the shop and is being prepared for shipment. We'll let you know as soon as it's on its way!

Thank you for shopping with Green Quick!
orderShippedSubject: Your Green Quick Order #{{orderId}} has Shipped!
orderShippedBody:
Hello {{userName}},

Your order #{{orderId}} is on its way! You can track its progress here: {{trackingLink}}

Thank you for shopping with Green Quick!
orderDeliveredSubject: Your Green Quick Order #{{orderId}} has been Delivered!
orderDeliveredBody:
Hello {{userName}},

Your order #{{orderId}} has been successfully delivered! We hope you enjoy your items.

We'd love to hear about your experience. Please consider leaving a review for your products and shops:
{{reviewLinksHtml}}

Thank you for shopping with Green Quick!
orderCancelledSubject: Your Green Quick Order #{{orderId}} has been Cancelled
orderCancelledBody:
Hello {{userName}},

Your order #{{orderId}} has been cancelled.

Reason: {{cancellationReason}}

{{refundStatusHtml}}

If you have any questions, please contact support.

Thank you for shopping with Green Quick!
orderCancelledRefundedStatus: The amount of {{totalAmount}} has been refunded to your original payment method. The refund should appear in your account within 5-10 business days.
orderCancelledRefundPendingStatus: A refund for the amount of {{totalAmount}} has been initiated and is currently processing. We will notify you once the refund is complete.
lowStockBody:
Hello {{userName}},

The stock for your product {{productName}} has reached the threshold.
Current stock: {{stock}}
Threshold: {{threshold}}

Please restock soon to keep it available for customers:
Go to Inventory Dashboard
outOfStockBody:
Hello {{userName}},

Your product {{productName}} is now out of stock.
It has been automatically marked as unavailable in your shop until you restock.

Please restock and update the inventory in your dashboard to make it visible again:
Go to Inventory Dashboard
